title: Mixed Duo #052 · 여 아워글래스 밤쉘·페르시안글램 / 남 파워리프터·로즈골드 글리터
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit Indian palace courtyard of pale sandstone with carved arches of standard height, low steps and a waist-high jali screen, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Iranian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, deep dark brown hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver round bell, a tin small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold anklets. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense folk-art floral motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Italian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, sparkling glitter dusted under the eyes with rose-gold eyeshadow, smooth light-olive skin, a gentle soft smile, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a copper teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a tin square-sided cowbell, a tin barrel-shaped weight, a bronze round bell, a gold small flared temple bell, a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver bracelets. Extremely long coffin nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large, thick, heavy and extremely strong man, far beyond any real person, built like a powerlifter. A huge barrel chest, enormously wide shoulders and back, a thick solid waist with a firm rounded belly over strong abs, massive arms, and enormous thick thighs and calves. Every part is large, dense and continuous rather than sharply cut. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), wide gold-leaf bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense eggshell-white scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping his hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
